title: CITIUSCOMM – Keeping You One Step Ahead!
h2: Ready to Engineer Your Next-Gen Network?
p: End-to-end security, networking, wireless, and optical solutions engineered for high performance.
Explore our comprehensive range of carrier-grade networking hardware, optical distribution systems, and security suites.

As the technology required to run your business evolves, so does the volume and complexity of threats against it. Our robust security portfolio shields your cloud workloads, core infrastructure, and edge perimeter with proactive DDoS mitigation, Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), and AI-driven intrusion prevention.

Innovative technologies drive business performance today, and it’s the network that powers this digital age. Our carrier-grade switches and routers connect data centers, metro access rings, and regional backbones with wire-speed IP MPLS routing and automated SD-WAN overlay fabrics.

There’s a wide range of 4G/5G Core Products which provide service management and control of 4G/5G services. We deliver carrier-grade indoor and outdoor WiFi 6/6E access points alongside disaggregated private 5G RAN and standalone 5G core elements.

Broadband delivery requires flexible, modular, and high-density GPON/XGS-PON optical distribution. We supply carrier-tested OLT chassis, modular PON cards, and cost-effective ONUs/ONTs backed by on-ground staging and rapid field support pan-India.
Browse detailed architectural solutions tailored for telecom, cable, enterprise, and cloud environments.
Routers, switches, and software-defined network management.
GPON, point-to-point, OLT and ONT deployments nationwide.
